## PR type (use Conventional Commits for the title)

- [ ] feat   — new feature
- [ ] fix    — bug fix
- [ ] docs   — documentation only
- [ ] build  — build system / dependencies
- [ ] ci     — CI / workflows
- [ ] refactor / test / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] Builds: `./gradlew assembleDebug`
- [ ] Tests: `./gradlew test`
- [ ] Lint: `./gradlew lintDebug`
- [ ] No new secrets / `.env` / keystores committed
- [ ] Existing `.md` docs kept in sync (no files silently removed)
- [ ] PRD requirement referenced (e.g. "F2") where applicable
